events.event_hazard: Hurricane Sandy storm surge flooding, power outages, and petroleum infrastructure disruption
key_impacts: Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
In New York City, storm surge flooding exceeded 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.

As of 2012-11-06, two refineries in New Jersey (Hess Port Reading and Phillips 66 Bayway in Linden) were shut down, resulting in the loss of 26.3% of the total operating capacity of 1,170,200 barrels per day.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate because of the outage.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn emergently evacuated all patients due to the outage.
